name: advisor
description: Fail-open post-turn critique. One prompt, one parsed note ({severity, text}). Internal: the agent loop injects the note; this guest is the completion + dialect so a CLI or hook runs the same review. Input: {"summary":"...","provider":"optional"}.

provider.description: Optional provider name. Empty uses the harness default.
